description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken White Magic Mode I (Minwu)] and [White Magic Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken White Magic Mode I (Minwu)
description.text: White Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, White Magic abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped White Magic abilities after using 1/2/3+ White Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken White Magic Mode II (Minwu)], removes [Dual Awoken White Magic Mode I (Minwu)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken White Magic Mode II (Minwu)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, White Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for White Magic abilities

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: White Magic Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: White Magic abilities deal 5% more damage
